description:
Prepare offline-proven installed Theseus entrypoints for local review, pr-arm/gate invocation and the gateway host. Inventory scripts/oracle_local_review.py, scripts/pr_arm.py, Makefile launchers, _project/scripts/oracle_gateway_host.sh install-omp/gateway-clients commands and trusted export code. Preserve local findings/dispute behaviour, credential scrubbing, cache/trusted-input digest and fetch-failure fail-closed handling. Gateway host first-stage verification remains consumer-owned and uses the trusted lock. Preserve ~/.cache/benchbox/omp, existing gateway client IDs and run/plist paths unless an owner-approved quiet-time restart replaces them.
Maintain a source-sync ledger: each BenchBox commit touching extraction inventory since baseline maps to a Theseus port commit, explicit no-op rationale, or pending port. Include promotion-path changes. Ledger is reviewed migration evidence, not session scratch. No source-freeze claim while it has pending entries.
Guardrails: install/export helpers may be staged outside active launchers until cutover; no dual authority or fallback to embedded engine. No running host, shared clients.json regeneration, agent restart or live gateway use here. Stage exact authorized paths, preserve user work and normal PR checks.
